landing.title: SECURE SMS MESSAGING
landing.description1: DekuSMS is an SMS app. You can use it as a standalone app or as a Gateway client to send your incoming messages to your cloud server! You can also configure it as a listener to your RabbitMQ server and transform your device into an SMS sending machine.
landing.description2: You and anyone else using Deku? Turn on E2EE messaging and send SMS messages using the Signal protocol.

features.heading: FEATURES
features.forwardTitle: Forward SMS to the Cloud – Even When Offline
features.forwardText:
Incoming SMS messages can be forwarded to your cloud server!
The protocols used include HTTP(s), SMTP and sFTP.
Messages can be queued until an internet connection is detected, thanks to Android studio advance work features.
features.googleDesignTitle: Familiar Google Messages Design, Seamlessly Integrated
features.googleDesignText: Used Google Messages and enjoyed the look and feel? Deku SMS works with the same design, bringing in the seamless nature of the SMS app you are already used to.
features.rabbitMQTitle: Send SMS via RabbitMQ with Reliable Server Communication
features.rabbitMQText: You can send SMS messages from your phone by allowing your phone to communicate with a RabbitMQ server. Android-specific features have been integrated to make communication long-lasting and efficient.
features.e2eeTitle: End-to-End Encrypted SMS with Forward Secrecy
features.e2eeText: You can send and receive E2EE encrypted SMS messages with fellow peers using Deku SMS. Messages support forward secrecy and SMS-accessible technologies are used in making the encrypted payloads suitable for SMS messaging.

downloads.heading: DOWNLOAD
downloads.description: DekuSMS app is available on several platforms. Download it and use it as your default SMS app.

install.question: How do I install DekuSMS?
install.answer: You can download the app from the official website or supported stores depending on your device.

secure.question: Is DekuSMS secure?
secure.answer: Yes, DekuSMS uses encryption to protect your messages.

multidevice.question: Can I use DekuSMS on more than one device?
multidevice.answer: It currently supports one primary device per account.

offline.question: Does DekuSMS work offline?
offline.answer: Messages are queued and sent automatically when connection is restored.
